Conjecture: a(n) = ceiling(sqrt(prime(n+1)*prime(n+2))). - _Thomas Ordowski_, Mar 22 2013 [This requires gaps to be smaller than approximately sqrt(8p) and hence requires a result on prime gaps slightly stronger than that provided by the Riemann hypothesis. - _Charles R Greathouse IV_, Jul 13 2022]

Conjectures: a(n) == 1 (mod 80); for fixed k, the sequence a(n) (mod k) eventually becomes periodic. - _Peter Bala_, Dec 19 2019

Conjecture: a(n) = [x^n] G(x)^(2*n), where G(x) = (1 + x)*(1 - 6*x + x^2)/(2*x) + (x^2 - 1)*sqrt(1 - 14*x + x^2)/(2*x) = 1 + 10*x + 81*x^2 + 720*x^3 + .... The algebraic function G(x) satisfies the quadratic equation x*G(x)^2 - (1 - 5*x - 5*x^2 + x^3)*G(x) + (1 + x)^4 = 0. Cf. A001450. - _Peter Bala_, Oct 27 2022
